blocks.h2: Is It Time for a New Toilet?
blocks.body: If your toilet is older, clogs often or runs no matter how many parts you replace, a new one may save money and hassle. Today's toilets use far less water per flush and clear the bowl well. Comfort-height models are easier for many people to use. If the floor around the old toilet is soft, we'll check the flange and subfloor before setting the new one, so it doesn't rock or leak later.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Toilet Work
blocks.body: Small parts like flappers and fill valves are quick fixes. Resetting a toilet on a new seal takes longer. In older homes, a corroded flange or soft floor can add work. A new toilet depends on the model. We check first and quote one flat price.

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.answer: Usually a worn flapper or fill valve. Both are quick repairs.

items.preview: Loose bolts or a damaged flange.
items.answer: Loose bolts or a damaged flange. We fix the flange and reset it.

items.q: Why does my toilet clog so often?
items.preview: An older toilet or a line problem.
items.answer: Older toilets clog more. If it's newer, the drain line may need clearing.

items.q: Can you install a toilet I bought?
items.answer: Yes, with a new seal and supply line.

items.q: How long does it take to replace a toilet?
items.answer: Usually a couple of hours, longer if the flange needs repair.

items.q: Why does my toilet run on its own every so often?
items.preview: A slow leak through the flapper.
items.answer: That's called phantom flushing. Water slowly leaks past the flapper and the tank refills. A new flapper fixes it.

items.q: Can you fix a toilet that won't stop gurgling?
items.preview: We'll check the vent and drain.
items.answer: Gurgling often points to a partial clog or a vent problem. We'll find which.

items.q: How much does toilet repair cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and whether you're repairing or replacing. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
